Transitive via docs/architecture/module-map.md: the only change is one sentence in ExtensionNotificationBindings saying a marker never splits a turn and is held until the turn closes; this document's own claims do not depend on it and stay accurate.

ExtensionNotificationBindings now states the held-marker rule: a marker arriving during a turn is held by runtime-event-projection.ts until emitAssistantTurn closes the turn, then follows its single canonical answer row with the duringTurn label from extension-transcript-markers.ts; between turns it renders in place. extensionHandlers.ts's transcript.marker return is documented as intent only. Checked against the projection, the label table and the end-of-turn answer-read test.

runtime-event-projection.ts now holds markers during an open turn and emits them after the turn's row; the turn row, tool, approval and policy-denied projection paths this document describes are unchanged (no split, canonical ids kept).
